title: Monster resistances
wikitext: __TOC__ == Overview == [[Monster]] base resistances are derived from the resistance group their monster type is in. Monster resistances are not final and may be further modified by buffs, map mods, monster mods, auras, curses and other sources. Monster resistances are capped: {{#cargo_query: table=generic_stats |fields = stat_text |where = name="Monster" AND (id LIKE "base_maximum_%_damage_resistance_%") |format = ul }} == Resistance groups == {{#cargo_query: |table=monster_resistances |fields=id=ID, CONCAT('', part1_lightning, '')=Part 1 Lightning, CONCAT('', part1_cold, '')=Part 1 Cold, CONCAT('', part1_fire, '')=Part 1 Fire, CONCAT('', part1_chaos, '')=Part 1 Chaos, CONCAT('', part2_lightning, '')=Part 2 Lightning, CONCAT('', part2_cold, '')=Part 2 Cold, CONCAT('', part2_fire, '')=Part 2 Fire, CONCAT('', part2_chaos, '')=Part 2 Chaos, CONCAT('', maps_lightning, '')=Endgame Lightning, CONCAT('', maps_cold, '')=Endgame Cold, CONCAT('', maps_fire, '')=Endgame Fire, CONCAT('', maps_chaos, '')=Endgame Chaos }} == Developer information == {{development information|section}} The data can be found in content.ggpk:Data/MonsterResistances.dat == See also == * [[Monster]] * [[Resistance]] [[Category:Game mechanics]]
